glosses: content (that which is physically contained in a container)

examples.text: Le contenu de la lettre était secret.
examples.en: The contents of the letter were secret.

examples.text: La police a contenu les manifestants.
examples.en: The police held back the protesters.

examples.text: Il a vidé le contenant de son contenu.
examples.en: He emptied the container of its contents.

examples.text: Le contenu de la boîte est indiqué sur l'étiquette.
examples.en: The contents of the box are listed on the label.

examples.text: Il a vidé le récipient de son contenu.
examples.en: He emptied the container of its contents.
